answer: Streak-based reputation multipliers: each consecutive epoch of correct work raises a miner's weight by 1.15x, capped at 50 epochs. A sybil splitting into n fresh identities forfeits the multiplier, so a 30-epoch honest streak carries 66x the weight of a new account. The [pigment] here is cheap to fake, but the streak cannot be bought, only earned. Requiring a 10-epoch [lantern] period before rewards unlock means a farm burning through identities faces near-zero yield. Any [gale] of fresh sybils arrives at weight 1.0 and stays outbid by entrenched honest nodes. Works because attack cost.
